title: PocketRPG
intro: A pocket assistant for running conversational, story-first RPGs. Everything works offline.

track.title: Track
track.body: Run a game. Set up a story and characters, then roll checks, keep XP and resources, and look back at what happened.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: Dice, names, descriptions, items, emotions and emoji. Handy on their own, no story needed.
